explanation.en: “more carbon than all the world’s forests combined” → forests. “Combined” is not needed: the meaning is complete.
explanation.kk: «more carbon than all the world’s forests combined» → forests. «Combined» артық: мағына толық.
explanation.ru: «more carbon than all the world’s forests combined» → forests. «Combined» лишнее: смысл уже полный.

RT-AC-SC-05-Q1.quote: they store more carbon than all the world’s forests combined

explanation.en: Plants do not fully decay because there is “too little oxygen for them to decay completely”. The answer oxygen comes right after “too little”.
explanation.kk: Өсімдіктер толық ыдырамайды, себебі онда «too little oxygen for them to decay completely». Oxygen жауабы мәтінде «too little» сөзінен кейін бірден тұр.
explanation.ru: Растения не разлагаются полностью, потому что там «too little oxygen for them to decay completely». Ответ oxygen стоит в тексте сразу после «too little».

RT-AC-SC-05-Q2.quote: where there is too little oxygen for them to decay completely

explanation.en: “peat could be cut and burned as fuel” → fuel. “Farming” is the other reason for drainage in the same sentence.
explanation.kk: «peat could be cut and burned as fuel» → fuel. «Farming» — сол сөйлемдегі құрғатудың басқа себебі.
explanation.ru: «peat could be cut and burned as fuel» → fuel. «Farming» — другая причина осушения из того же предложения.

RT-AC-SC-05-Q3.quote: so that peat could be cut and burned as fuel

explanation.en: “using small dams made of peat or wood” → dams. “Small” is already there, and the noun is plural.
explanation.kk: «using small dams made of peat or wood» → dams. «Small» сөйлемде тұр, сан — көпше.
explanation.ru: «using small dams made of peat or wood» → dams. «Small» уже в предложении, число — множественное.

RT-AC-SC-05-Q4.quote: blocking the drainage ditches using small dams made of peat or wood

explanation.en: “rose by 30 centimetres within two years” → 30 centimetres (“30 cm” is also accepted). “Two years” is already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «rose by 30 centimetres within two years» → 30 centimetres (30 cm да есептеледі). «Two years» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «rose by 30 centimetres within two years» → 30 centimetres (30 cm тоже засчитывается). «Two years» уже стоит в предложении.
